topic_summary: Division 293 tax is an additional 15% tax on concessional super contributions for high-income earners whose income plus certain super contributions exceed $250,000 (from 2017–18 onwards) or $300,000 (2012–13 to 2016–17), under the Income Tax Assessment Act 1997. Competitors explain what Division 293 is and how to calculate it, but none address planning strategies, mitigation techniques, or how to structure income and contributions to minimise or avoid the tax.
